messages.author: 764aaaa14db2104d
messages.subject: Requesting Help
parts:
Dear INLA experts,
I have tried to run my r-code on a Linux server.
However, I have trouble installing the R-INLA package on the server, and my code runs on smaller machines such as laptops with Windows operating systems.

I have tried different INLA versions and installing using:

remotes::install_version("INLA", version="22.05.03",repos=c(getOption("repos"),INLA="https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/testing"), dep=TRUE

On the server, R 4.1.2 has been installed. 
I got the following error messages

ERROR: configuration failed for package ‘textshaping’
* removing ‘/home/gezahemw/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/4.1/textshaping’
ERROR: dependency ‘textshaping’ is not available for package ‘ragg’
* removing ‘/home/gezahemw/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/4.1/ragg’
ERROR: dependency ‘ragg’ is not available for package ‘pkgdown’
* removing ‘/home/gezahemw/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/4.1/pkgdown’

 and warning messages:
Warning messages:
1: In i.p(...) :
  installation of package ‘textshaping’ had non-zero exit status
2: In i.p(...) : installation of package ‘ragg’ had non-zero exit status
3: In i.p(...) :
  installation of package ‘pkgdown’ had non-zero exit status

And sometimes it has given a "INLA has been crashed" message. 

Any suggestions to solve the problem are highly appreciated!

Thank you!

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Requesting Help
parts:
I am going fit a spatio-temporal model for areal data.
The data and the code used to implement the model is given below:
### import the data (give the exact directory of the excel data from your computer)
M_Dat <- read.csv("C:/Users/user/Desktop/Gezahegn.csv")


### Import the shapefile ()

library(spData)
library(sp)
library(PROJ)
library(geos)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
shapef <- st_read("C:/Users/user/Desktop/shapefile/Amhara_woreda_recent_boundary.shp")


### Generating spatial weight matrix in R-INLA

temp <- poly2nb(shapef)
nb2INLA("Amhara.graph", temp)
Amhara_shape <- paste(getwd(),"/Amhara.graph",sep="")
Amhara_shape


## Type I interaction

## Type I interaction: Model specification

Type_I<-Y~X1+X2+X3+X4+X5+X6+X7+X8+X9+X10+X11
+f(FiD1,model="bym",graph=Amhara_shape,hyper = list(prec.unstruct=list(prior="loggamma",param=c(1,0.001)),
prec.spatial=list(prior="loggamma",param=c(1,0.001)))) +
f(Month_1,model="rw2") +
f(Month_2,model="iid") +
f(FiD.T,model="iid")

Mod_I<- inla(formula =Type_I, family ="gpoisson",data=M_Dat,offset=Pop,
control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE),
control.compute=list(config=TRUE,cpo=TRUE,dic=TRUE,waic=TRUE))

summary(Mod_I)

Mod_I_2 <- inla(formula =Type_I, family ="nbinomial",data=M_Dat,offset=Pop,
control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE),
control.compute=list(config=TRUE,cpo=TRUE,dic=TRUE,waic=TRUE))

summary(Mod_I_2)
